title: Bug Report
description: Schema for a bug report produced by Agente06_QaEngineer during a Gate 4 evaluation.

bug_id.description: Bug identifier. Increment per QA Report.

severity.description: Bug severity: CRITICAL=auth bypass/data loss/security; HIGH=feature broken/user blocked; MEDIUM=degraded UX/workaround exists; LOW=cosmetic

title.description: Short, precise title describing what is wrong.

component.description: High-level component where the bug was found (e.g., Task Management, Authentication, Navigation).

file_path.description: File path where the bug is located (e.g., features/tasks/actions/createTask.ts).

line_reference.description: Optional line number or range where the bug manifests (e.g., line 24, lines 30-45).

description.description: Precise description of the bug, including what condition triggers it.

reproduction_steps.description: Ordered steps to reproduce the bug.

expected_behavior.description: What should happen according to the acceptance criterion.

acceptance_criterion_violated.description: The AC-NNN identifier that this bug violates, or 'SECURITY' / 'COVERAGE' for non-AC findings.

test_that_found_it.description: The test file and test name that first revealed this bug, if applicable.

recommendation.description: Specific recommendation for the developer to fix this bug. Include the approach, not just 'fix the bug'.

responsible_agent.description: Which Dev agent is responsible for fixing this bug.

regression_test_required.description: True if a regression test must be added alongside the fix (required for all CRITICAL and HIGH bugs).

escalate_to_security.description: True if this bug should also be escalated to Agente07_DevSecOps (required for CRITICAL security bugs).
